mapper.update: CREATE TABLE ${tableName} ( CLIENT_KEY VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, MO_KEY VARCHAR(50), MO_NUMBER VARCHAR(16), SENDER VARCHAR(16), CALLBACK VARCHAR(16), RCV_DATE DATETIME, INS_DATE DATETIME, PRODUCT VARCHAR(10), MSG VARCHAR(4000), TELCO VARCHAR(10), STATUS VARCHAR(10), REPLAY_DATE DATETIME, REPLAY_MSG VARCHAR(160), SUBJECT VARCHAR(200), CONTENT_CNT INTEGER, CONTENT_LIST VARCHAR(1000), CONSTRAINT PK_${tableName} PRIMARY KEY (CLIENT_KEY) )

CREATE TABLE ${tableName} ( MO_NUMBER VARCHAR(16), ALARM_YN VARCHAR(1) DEFAULT'N', ALARM_DAY_TIME VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT'09:00~18:00', ALARM_DAY_RECEIVERS VARCHAR(200), ALARM_DAY_SENDER VARCHAR(20), ALARM_NIGHT_TIME VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT'18:00~09:00', ALARM_NIGHT_RECEIVERS VARCHAR(200), ALARM_NIGHT_SENDER VARCHAR(20), ALARM_MSG VARCHAR(160), AUTO_REPLY_YN VARCHAR(1) DEFAULT'N', AUTO_REPLY_MSG VARCHAR(160) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${tableName} ( CLIENT_KEY, MO_KEY, MO_NUMBER, SENDER, CALLBACK, RCV_DATE, INS_DATE, PRODUCT, MSG, TELCO, STATUS, REPLAY_DATE, REPLAY_MSG, SUBJECT, CONTENT_CNT, CONTENT_LIST ) VALUES ( #{parameter.key}, #{parameter.moKey}, #{parameter.moNumber}, #{parameter.sender}, #{parameter.callback}, CONVERT(DATETIME,STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(#{parameter.receiveDate},9,0,' '),12,0,':'),15,0,':')), GETDATE(), #{parameter.product}, #{parameter.message}, #{parameter.telco}, #{parameter.status}, CONVERT(DATETIME,STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(#{parameter.replyDate},9,0,' '),12,0,':'),15,0,':')) #{parameter.replyMessage}, #{parameter.subject}, #{parameter.contentCount}, #{parameter.contentListString} )
